transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you here today?

Well, I came in because... it's my husband’s sister. She’s been working this family business situation so she can get control of the money and push me out of making any decisions. People keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing. I've been watching her do this for more than a year now.
Have you ever felt convinced this was happening even when other people showed you evidence that it was not?

Well, like I was just saying, folks are always trying to smooth it over. They try to tell me I'm misunderstanding things, or they'll point to some paper or bank statement to try and prove she's just helping out. 

But yes, I stay convinced. Because I know what I've been seeing with my own two eyes for over a year now. She is working this whole situation to get control of the money and push me out of the decisions. It really doesn't matter what they try to show me or say to me, because I know what she's actually doing.
Have you heard or seen things that other people around you did not seem to notice?

No, I haven't. I mean, I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, if that's what you're asking. It's just... it's just the things she does right out in the open, or the little things she says when we're all together. It's real life stuff, not... not anything like that.
Have there been any times when you felt unusually energized or high, with much less need for sleep than usual?

No, I can't say I have. I sleep just fine most nights, usually getting my regular seven or eight hours. I haven't had any times where I felt super energized or like I didn't need to sleep. I'm just... regular, I guess. It's just the stress with my sister-in-law that keeps me up sometimes, but nothing like what you're talking about.
Do you think your sister-in-law is doing this through something unusual or impossible, like special powers or a hidden device?

No, nothing like that. She doesn't have any kind of special powers or... or hidden gadgets or anything crazy like that. She's just a regular person using regular, sneaky ways to get what she wants. It's just manipulation and getting into my brother's ear, you know? Just normal, everyday plotting to get her hands on the money. There's no magic or science fiction stuff involved.
Has this belief about your sister-in-law’s motives ever been part of hearing voices or seeing things that others could not?

No, like I said before, I don't hear voices or see things. It's not like that at all. It's just... I just know what she's doing because I see how she acts and hear what she actually says to him. It's all right there in front of me, not some voice in my head telling me about it.
Has this belief about your sister-in-law caused problems in your work, relationships, or day-to-day life?

Not really with my everyday life, no. I mean, I still keep up with my quilting group and choir practice. I go to my GED lessons and do my senior walks just like I always have. My day-to-day is fine. 

Mostly, it's just changed how much I trust my husband's sister... and, well, which family gatherings I feel comfortable going to. If I know she's going to be there acting like that, I might just skip it to avoid the headache. But other than that, my life is pretty much normal.
Has this belief about your sister-in-law been going on for at least six months?

Yes, it's been longer than six months. I'd say... it's been going on for about a year and two months now. It all really started back when we began having those arguments over the family care planning. Ever since then, it's just been very clear what she's up to.
Have you had any other beliefs that other people would say are unusual or hard to explain?

No, nothing like that. It's really just the situation with my sister-in-law. I don't have any other... unusual ideas or anything people would find hard to explain. Everything else with me is just normal, everyday stuff.
